description: Human-reviewed company/tag decisions used to measure assignment precision and recall. These are deliberately unambiguous cases from the committed fixture corpus: the goal is to catch a regression that flips an obvious decision, not to estimate accuracy from a large sample. Tag ids refer to the fixture ontology in pipeline/fixture_model.py; for a real run, reviewed pairs should be added against real tag ids.

judgments.note: CircuitHub runs a robotic electronics factory; delivery is unambiguously physical.
Named customers are Tesla, NASA and Zipline. The buyer is an organisation.
Codecademy's learner is an individual acting for themselves.
An online learning platform requires no field operations or hardware.
RethinkDB is a database; its direct user is a software engineer.
Listia connects two sides of a trade in used goods.
A consumer trading app is not sold to engineers.
Medigram states HIPAA compliance; the domain carries legal obligations.
Described explicitly as workflow and collaboration software.
PadMapper's user is a person looking for an apartment.
Apartment search itself carries no sector-specific legal obligation.
Octopart searches electronic component catalogues, which are record-shaped.
An analytics product operates on tabular event and metric data.
Analytics software requires no facilities or field work.
